title: BPSSC Bihar Police SI Mains Result 2026
intro: Short Information : Bihar Police Subordinate Service Commission (BPSSC) has released the mains result for the post of Police Sub-Inspector. This recruitment was released for 1799 posts. Applications for the BPSSC Bihar Police SI Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 26, 2025, to October 26, 2025. The mains examination was held on 27 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BPSSC Bihar Police SI Mains Result 2026 which has given below.
importantDates: Re-Upload Photo/ Sign : 26 November to 03 December2025
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
